decisions.decision: foreign_flow_resid implementation: 20-day rolling sum per Ticker, then shift(1L) per Ticker — this passes C9 lag at the single-ticker level. Cross-sectional residualization regression is run inside the same Date group; the residuals depend only on contemporaneous Size_log and AvgTV20_log within that Date, both of which are themselves t-1 lagged via LIQ_DT/RAWDATA structure. Risk is LOW but not zero: if an indexing error caused contemporaneous data to leak, would not be detected by this audit.
decisions.action: Defer detailed C9 verification to Forge S6 with explicit Lookahead_detector.R scan request. Note in alpha_package.json pit_compliance.C9: 'PASS conditional on Forge S6 audit confirming no implicit indexing leak in residualize-by-Date block.'
